hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; [ -z "$f" ] && exit 0; case "$f" in *scripts/*.groovy|*lib/*.groovy|*test/*.groovy|*gradle/packageAddon.gradle) root=$(cd "$(dirname "$f")" && git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; [ -x "$root/tools/check-conventions.sh" ] && bash "$root/tools/check-conventions.sh" ;; esac; }

jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' | { read -r cmd; case "$cmd" in *"git commit"*) if gradle check >&2; then exit 0; else printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"gradle check failed; see stderr above for the gradle output and fix the violations before committing."}}'; fi ;; esac; }
